requiredCurrentQualificationFacts: observed account value is within test-account threshold
transfer permission absent where venue exposes it
rules: live endpoint semantics must never be relabeled as Demo or Testnet
Owner Principal mandate permits non-production qualification use of these live accounts but does not grant production trading
no order may be submitted from user assertion of low balance alone; current authoritative balance evidence is mandatory
test order notional is capped at 1 quote unit unless the Owner Principal changes the test capital envelope
if venue minimum notional exceeds the cap, the test must stop rather than raise the cap automatically
withdrawal and transfer operations remain forbidden
any ambiguous dispatch is RETAIN and must reconcile before retry
non-matching validation canaries do not imply authorization for a real matching-engine order
while orderSubmissionAdmission is NOT_ADMITTED no executor credential path is bound into this policy; read-only observer bindings remain separate
